title: DynamoDB DocumentClient throws Unsupported type passed when an item contains a Date or class instance
symptoms: Error: Unsupported type passed: Tue Oct 14 2026 ... Pass options.convertClassInstanceToMap=true to marshall typeof object as map attribute.
Writes fail as soon as a createdAt Date object is added
Items built from ORM or class instances fail while plain objects work
cause: The v3 marshaller only converts plain objects, arrays, sets, and primitives. A Date is a class instance, and DynamoDB has no date type, so the SDK refuses it.
fix: Convert dates to ISO strings or epoch numbers before writing. Use convertClassInstanceToMap only for your own classes, since it would turn a Date into an empty map.
